scientific_integrity: The general finite-dimensional stationary law, GEM stick-breaking and classical Simpson moments are credited to prior mathematical literature; finite checks support but cannot prove infinite/asymptotic claims. The submitted result consists of a sharp shape classification and a conditional Gaussian-mixture high-dimensional fluctuation theorem.
scientific_limitations: No thermal diffusion or anisotropic confinement; fixed strictly positive tumble-to-trap ratio in high dimension; general GEM representation and finite-dimensional moment framework are prior literature. Independent validation remains outstanding; unindexed stronger high-dimensional random-barycenter results remain a priority risk.
title: Dimension-five kurtosis boundary and non-self-averaging radial fluctuations of a trapped run-and-tumble particle
